samar (oncall-net): :rotating_light: multiple customers reporting sustained 502s and timeouts from hosted inference in asia-southeast1, spike started ~00:33 UTC

mira (support): which customers and any repro steps?

samar (oncall-net): ACME-app and a couple of smaller tenants. They hit /v1/generate and got intermittent 502 / gateway timeouts. Example they pasted: see below.

mira (support): paste curl + response if available

samar (oncall-net): ```curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (34.123.45.67) port 443 (#0)
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
{"error":"gateway_timeout"}
```

kai (eng-runtime): Runtime traces show repeated connection resets between edge gateway and backend pool. High tail latency (2–4s) preceding 502s. No obvious CPU/GPU saturation. Any network telemetry?

samar (oncall-net): captured short tcpdump at edge-egress-asia-southeast1a: ```16:33:12.123456 IP 10.32.5.8.443 > 10.32.7.9.58912: Flags [P.], seq 1:501, ack 1, win 6432
16:33:12.223789 IP 10.32.5.8 > 10.32.7.9: dup ack (3), out-of-order, retransmit
```  shows dup acks and retransmits, packets out-of-order.

teja (eng-sre): Provider side (AS64523) telemetry shows a brief ECMP reshuffle and BGP withdraws at ~00:33 UTC in that POP. We saw packet loss spikes ~0.8–3% for ~6 minutes and increased RTT variance across AZ boundaries.

julien (customer-success): ACME says the errors started right after our canary deploy (+~2m) and their SREs fired paged alarms. They're requesting an RCA and temporary mitigation ASAP.

samar (oncall-net): quick mitigation applied: bumped routing preference to peering-2 for affected prefix and forced failover away from provider AS64523 for the hot path. Error rate dropped noticeably. Rolling back the canary also reduced traffic pressure on the hot backend.

kai (eng-runtime): also enabled aggressive prefix/KV cache on gateway and reduced batch size to lower simultaneous backend connections. Deployed config change PR #4321.

mira (support): I notified ACME SREs, provided repro curl and list of our mitigations. They accepted a temporary route change and asked for ETA 2h for complete stabilization.

teja (eng-sre): opened ticket with provider (AS64523) and attached PCAP and BGP state dump. Requested they disable ECMP reweighting during peak and add BFD checks for faster detection. I'll own the provider follow-up.

incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3187654321, severity: P2

samar (oncall-net): update 00:50 UTC: error rate down to ~0.1% for affected customers, occasional single 502s only. Monitoring continues.

julien (customer-success): thanks, ACME will validate on their end and confirm in 1h. Please share RCA draft when ready.

teja (eng-sre): provisional RCA summary: transient ECMP/BGP reshuffle at regional provider -> path asymmetry and packet reordering -> dup acks/retransmits -> backend TCP connections experienced tail timeouts -> gateway returned 502s under retry/backpressure. Mitigations: route pinning to alternate peer, provider ticket, BFD route health checks, route dampening, runtime caching + reduced batch sizes.

kai (eng-runtime): runtime change + caching is live and dashboards have stabilized. Will keep sampling KV miss rate and tail latency.

mira (support): I'll keep the customer ticket open and check back in 3h to confirm closure if no regressions.

samar (oncall-net): final: incident marked resolved for now. RCA meeting scheduled 10:00 PST tomorrow to discuss durable mitigations (peering SLAs, automated route failover). Closing thread unless any regressions reported. :thumbsup:
